title: From shelled kernels to market: kukui (candlenut)
prompt: Slide the seam left and right to compare loose shelled kukui kernels with candlenuts bundled for sale at a Southeast Asian market. Notice how the raw kernels are portioned and packaged for trade.

before.alt: Loose shelled kukui (candlenut) kernels, pale and rounded, spread out together.
before.caption: Shelled kernels

after.alt: Candlenuts portioned into small clear plastic bags and bundled for sale at a Southeast Asian market.
after.caption: Bundled for market
